text:
The plate holds only leftovers: a few tomato slices (about 2–3 slices, roughly 40 g) and some shreds of lettuce, with plastic wrap that is not food. Tomato is about 18 kcal per 100 g, so 40 g comes to roughly 7 kcal. The lettuce adds a negligible amount, and I assumed about 5 g of it, so the total is around 8 kcal.
